granular.name: get_tracking
granular.description: Get one linked shipment's SKU, units, carrier status, latest event, estimate and timestamps. Availability unavailable means carrier evidence could not be retrieved; null status is unknown, not proof of a delay or delivery.

parameters.title: get_tracking
parameters.description: Get one linked shipment's SKU, units, carrier status, latest event, estimate and timestamps. Availability unavailable means carrier evidence could not be retrieved; null status is unknown, not proof of a delay or delivery.

trackingId.description: A tracking ID returned by get_order. Read every shipment relevant to the question.

granular.name: get_order
granular.description: Get one order's status, promised delivery date, item quantities and linked payment, reservation and tracking IDs. Follow those IDs with the other tools for payment, warehouse and carrier evidence. Order status may lag carrier updates.

parameters.title: get_order
parameters.description: Get one order's status, promised delivery date, item quantities and linked payment, reservation and tracking IDs. Follow those IDs with the other tools for payment, warehouse and carrier evidence. Order status may lag carrier updates.

orderId.description: The order ID, for example ORD-1001.

granular.name: get_payment
granular.description: Get one linked payment's capture status and last update. Dispatch requires a captured payment.

parameters.title: get_payment
parameters.description: Get one linked payment's capture status and last update. Dispatch requires a captured payment.

paymentId.description: A payment ID returned by get_order.

granular.name: get_reservation
granular.description: Get one linked warehouse reservation: SKU, units, status and last update. Backordered units are not available to dispatch; ready_for_dispatch units are available; dispatched units have left the warehouse.

parameters.title: get_reservation
parameters.description: Get one linked warehouse reservation: SKU, units, status and last update. Backordered units are not available to dispatch; ready_for_dispatch units are available; dispatched units have left the warehouse.

reservationId.description: A reservation ID returned by get_order. An order can have more than one.

focused.name: get_order_support_context
focused.description: Get the operational evidence for one order-support question: order status, promise, item quantities, linked payment, warehouse reservations and carrier tracking with source timestamps. Order status may lag carrier updates. Dispatch requires captured payment; backordered units are not available, ready_for_dispatch units are available, dispatched units have left the warehouse. Tracking availability unavailable means unknown carrier evidence, not proof of a delay or delivery. Returns facts, not an assessment.
